text:
maria: Cutting a release candidate (candidate-v2026-04-15) for tonight's change window 00:30-02:30 UTC. Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/candidate-v2026-04-15@sha256:abc123def456. DB migration deferred to next cycle. Requesting sheriff-ops + prod-ops signoff. Release notes (brief):
- routing optimizer: reduced tail latency
- kv-cache warmup enabled (opt-in)
- telemetry: per-route cost breakdown

tom: quick q — are we pinning the model-serving image and doing a fallback image? fallback plan if KV warm fails?

ryan: smoke on staging ✅ (basic perf + smoke). plan: canary 5% -> 50% over 20m -> full, ramp steps at 5/20/50/100. feature flag `new-routing` default OFF; will enable in incremental steps during roll.

deploy-bot: [deploy-scheduler] Candidate queued: candidate-v2026-04-15 for 00:30 UTC. Operator: maria. Canary policy: 5m wait + metric checks. Command (ops):
```
./deploy promote --env=prod --image=gcr.io/redwood/candidate-v2026-04-15@sha256:abc123def456 --canary=5 --checks=telemetry,errors
```

lina: I'll draft the release note blurb and push to docs repo (will include migration defer note). tagging @lina for docs handoff.

sheriff-ops: QA + perf smoke passed on preprod. Verified KV warm behaviour and prefix caching. :thumbsup: Signoff granted conditional on rollback tag and runbook being uploaded. Please set `rollback-cand-1745554321`.

maria: Setting rollback tag and uploading short rollback runbook now. Runbook excerpt:
```
# rollback-cand-1745554321
1) Pause traffic: ./deploy scale --set=previous-image
2) Toggle feature flag: ffctl set new-routing off
3) Repoint router to previous canary
4) Verify error rate < 1% and latencies restored
```

tom: Added temporary circuit-breaker at edge with TTL=5m. If error rate > 5% over 1m during ramp, traffic will divert to previous image automatically.

deploy-bot: [deploy-runner] Promotion started at 00:30 UTC. Canary 5% applied. Running metric checks (errors, p50/p95 latency, cost delta).

deploy-bot: [deploy-runner] Canary checks passed. Promoting to 50% at 00:55 UTC.

deploy-bot: [deploy-runner] Full promotion complete at 01:20 UTC. Artifact gcr.io/redwood/candidate-v2026-04-15@sha256:abc123def456 is now live in prod.

ryan: Monitoring: no obvious regressions, latency delta +0.3%, error rate stable. Feature flag rollout at 50% currently, moving to 100% in 30m if stable.

sheriff-ops: Verified post-promote telemetry and release note pushed: https://docs.internal.redwood/release-notes/2026-04-15. Rollback tag present. :shipit: Closing out from ops side.

maria: Thanks team — releasing followups for observability alerts and cost dashboard update. Will file a brief post-deploy readout in #eng-releases tomorrow morning.
